post.caption:
Plants cannot move, so seeds evolved transport: helicopter wings, burrs that hook onto fur, coconuts that float across oceans, and fruit designed to be eaten and deposited elsewhere. Chillies are spicy to filter out mammals, because birds cannot taste capsaicin, fly further, and do not grind seeds with molars. We are the one species that seeks the punishment out.
